notes.title: Floating Islands of Nucifera
notes.content:
In light of countless requests to make a non VR Shop Keep Game Odooh Games Announcing another game called Floating Islands of Nucifera. Its a fantasy open-world shopkeep game, where you can unlock quests, summon champions to slaughter monsters in turn-based combat, take loot back to sell in your store, and haggle with customers over the cost. Please wishlist it and share your thoughts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1494650/Floating_Islands_of_Nucifera/

notes.title: Out of early access
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dealers,[/h1]
I kept this game in early access for some time now, even though I delivered everything I promised for this game. This game was never meant to grow big, rather a small casual game with low poly graphics. 
 [h2]Just to recap what was added to the game(some updates were promised, some were not):[/h2]
[list]
[*]Apartment (was not promised but added based on feedback)
[*]Gun Factory (was promised)
[*]New look (was not promised but I thought new look was better)
[*]Countless small features suggested by players 
[/list]

I just want to take a moment and thank all of you who supported me in this journey. I will still fix new discovered bugs in terms of development or updates it is the finish line for this game.

notes.title: Delivery Upgrade and Rotation
notes.content:
Hello Dealers,
I pushed a small patch based on feedback. 

Delivery upgrade booster - max was 20 now its 50.

Removed the delay timer for rotation

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
I made some minor updates to the tutorial mainly fixed the grammar issues.
Also, some changes to Vive Controls, a lot less sensitive.

notes.title: Update: Deal
notes.content:
Update Deal is now live. 
My apologies it took longer than I expected. This update brings some bug fixes, minor graphical optimization and achievements.

Illegal night deals are now fixed. When customers are denied during the day they will come back at night to buy the same item illegally but for higher price. Also, since its night and if item wanted by the customer is pistol or rifle then customer will carry brief case instead of a gun.

Added steam achievements.
Rebalanced game

Rotating no longer causes black screen and many other small bugs fixes.

notes.title: Magnet Update
notes.content:
Hello Dealers,
 This is a small update which brings a feature called... magnet. Now you don't have to psychically bend down to pick up guns. Instead just point a laser at the gun so it can come to you by itself. 

Also, I am 90% sure I fixed the problem with guns interfering with walking.
and some minor bugs.

Have fun!

EDIT: Friendly reminder today is the last day of the sale!

notes.title: April fools SALE!
notes.content:
Hello dealers!
  To honor my favorite month of the year and the recent update, I am running a sale this week. 

 Happy April Fools' day!

notes.title: Demand Update
notes.content:
Demand Update is now live!

Demand update brings new feature called... demand. In the back room there will be a list of weapons (rifles and pistols) which will be in demand. They will sell much faster than any other weapons.

Customer now will share their thoughts in "cloud thought" form.

fixed bug - where on second day of sale you would get bombarded with all customers showing up at once. Now they don't.
fixed bug - where guns interfered with walking. It still does but only 10% of the time.
other bug fixes that I forgot to record.

notes.title: 0.1.4 Tutorial
notes.content: Added a small tutorial, which gives an overview of the game. And explains some basic stuff.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 MONEY!!!
notes.content:
Added a small feature to adjust the amount of money you can start with. Minimum is 250 though.

Have fun!

notes.title: Trivials Update
notes.content:
Trivials Update is now live. 
Update brings reworked main menu. No longer accidental new games. If you have a save file, game will warn you before starting a new game. 

Now you can purchase update called "customer patience".  Increases time customers wait for their turn in the line. 

Some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 Customers
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 Just posted a small patch which fixes a bug with customer being stuck by the shelf.

notes.title: Apartment Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 Apartment update is now live. This update gives users an apartment. Now you can purchase electronics, furniture, kitchen utilities and many more items to decorate your apartment to make feel like home. Or more reason to spend all that money you made by selling guns!

SOME LVL-3 guns now have different skins. 

Also, this update brings few changes to the controls for locomotion. Controls have been inverted, now you move with your left hand and rotate with your right hand. The rest stays the same.

Bunch of bug fixes which I forgot to keep track of.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 (Close Store button and upgraded saves file)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
This update brings new feature, close store button. It is located in the backroom. 

Also, I improved save files. Game now remembers prices you set even after you close the game. Another improvement is when you load the game, all guns will get snapped to the shelves automatically. This is especially useful when you have a big store. 
Have fun!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0 (Naming Store and HTC VIVE Control edits)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
 This patch brings store naming. You can only name your store once per save.

Also, minor fixes and tweaks. I hope Htc Vive Conrol UI pointer works now, it is bound to menu button on right hand controller. If it doesn't work you can "touch" UI to interact with it, until I fix it. Thank you!

notes.title: Vive Controls, Desktop Screen and flair gun.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
 In this patch I added new Desktop Screen(Monitor). Instead of running to the back room to check on your XP or Reputation now you can just look at your Desktop Screen. 
Also, now you can use flair gun to shoot down thieves with your left hand and it won't activate the shelf store, I know it was an annoying bug I kept forgetting to fix it. 
Last but not least, I moved UI interaction laser from touchpad to A button (Menu Button for Vive users) I hope that fixes the issue with vive controllers.

Have fun!

notes.title: Pricing Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This patch brings new pricing ability. Before it was one button to increase price by 10. Now there are three buttons, green, yellow and red. Green increases price to the max green price. Yellow does the same, but red just increases price by 10. So now when the price of the gun is too high, you don't have to sit there increasing the price by 10, but rather just set it to highest green or yellow and DONE.

Also, buttons now have sound effect. For teleportation I thickened the line, so it is more visible now. Last but not least, I added some stuff in the delivery zone. So you don't have to bend to grab guns.

I am doing my best to improve this game, please be patient with me. 
Don't forget to follow me on twitter @OdoohGames

Thank you all for support!

notes.title: Teleportation
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
 I added new "feature" in the game. Now there is a teleportation. You can choose to play a game with locomotion or teleportation. 

If you choose teleportation option, you still can rotate using left controller and teleport using right controller.

Also this update comes with few bug fixes.
- fixed issue with customers coming at night. 
- fixed issue with customer leaving permit at night, which caused other customers get stuck in the waiting list.
- fixed issue with some guns never selling even if they were green.
- fixed issues with too many illegal buyers

I hope this helps with the gameplay. Have fun!

notes.title: Game wasn't running
notes.content: Sorry guys, I made a mistake and uploaded a wrong build which caused a game not to run. Its fixed now! Have fun!

notes.title: Tiny update
notes.content: I added a feature "remember price". Game will now remember previous price you set on the item so you don't have to set it again. Although, it will reset once you close the game. I will improve this feature sometime later.

notes.title: Update "Massive" is now live.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 From the first day of the release I collected all your feedback and I worked very hard on this game.

Update "Massive" 

Brings new look in general,
new town,
new guns,
new vehicles,
new store,
new armory,
and etc.

Some gameplay balancing and minor changes in controls. 

"Gun Factory" is included to this update.
Now you don't have to buy guns, you can just make them. (this is my first attempt at making a factory, so I may change it in the future)

You are now provided with a "taser gun" to knock down thieves.
Be careful, thieves look like any other customer however, they are not interested in paying at all. Once they get the gun they want to steal, they will literary run for it. The only way to stop them is by shooting them with taser gun.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where shelves were always red.
Fixed a bug which caused corruption of saved data
Fixed a bug where images of buyers wouldn't show on permit.
And many, many others. (I am sure there are many more still left).

I hope you all enjoy this new update. As always, if you like my work please follow me on twitter. @OdoohGames

Thank you all for support

notes.title: Small update.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
I posted a small update to fix some of the issues based on the feedback.

Main Menu Buttons are closer than they were before. (It was my mistake, I have big space in my room to test the game with).

Looks like weapons were not spawning on garbage bins, but now they do. 

Clock was not showing, and some other boards were not displaying message. That is fixed as well, now you can see clock, when your shop's hours. Which will help you plan accordingly.

I am working on skip night button. Which will allow you to skip the night and get back to the day, it will be helpful in early stages of the game where you didn't get many customer during the day.

If you have any suggestion, please post them in the community hub, I will try to implement/fix them asap. Thank you
